sc: Born at 28 weeks, stiff legs, scissoring, toe walking, arms nearly normal → Spastic diplegia (PVL)
Choreoathetosis and deafness after severe neonatal jaundice → Dyskinetic CP (kernicterus)
f: Non-progressive brain injury before 2 years → permanent disorder of movement and posture
Prematurity (PVL) · HIE · kernicterus · meningitis, encephalitis · congenital infections · stroke
Epilepsy (30–40%) · intellectual disability · squint, vision, hearing · feeding, aspiration, FTT · contractures, hip dislocation
Multidisciplinary: physiotherapy, OT, speech · botulinum toxin, baclofen · orthoses · treat epilepsy, nutrition
Spasticity, brisk reflexes, upgoing plantars · persistent primitive reflexes · delayed milestones
trap: Loss of skills is not CP: think neurodegenerative disease · hand preference before 18 months is abnormal · CP does not progress, but the signs change with growth
